QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] The Secret Black Wing Portal
QuestInfo.0: There is a strange device in front of the Mine that looks like a portal, but it isn't activated. You have numerous questions about the portal... Talk to #p2153001##k the #bportal manager. There must be a secret way to get to him from Road to the Mine 2.
QuestInfo.1:
The portal seems to have been made for the Black Wing management to travel quickly to Victoria Island. If you're not a part of the Black Wing management, you cannot use it. When you plead with #p2153001#, he asks you to eliminate #r#o3150002##k first.

#i4000607# #t4000607# #b#c4000607#/100#k
QuestInfo.2: When you eliminated #o3150002#, #p2153001# was thoroughly satisfied.

0.0:
Hmm... I don't think I've seen you around here before and you don't look like one of the townspeople. Are you a new member of the Black Wings? If so, that must be why you don't know about this device. What does this device look like to you?
#L0# #bIs this a portal?#l
#L1# Is this a weapon?#l
#L2# Is this a bathroom?#l
#k
0.1:
You're right. This device is a portal created to allow the Black Wing bosses to go back and forth from Victoria Island easily. It is obviously connected to Victoria Island.
#L0##bWow, the Black Wings have truly amazing technology.#l
#L1#Which bosses use this device?#l
#L2#Can I go to Victoria Island too?#l
#k
0.2:
Normal guys like you really have no reason to go so far. If you have a mission that takes you there, you'll have to show me your Orders...
#L0# #bI lost my Orders!#l
#L1#I want to see my children! I left them behind in Victoria Island...#l
#L2# If you don't let me through, I'm going to EAT YOU!#l
#k
0.3: My, my, but you look so young! You must miss your kids terribly. Maybe I should let you through, just this once. I don't know, though. Should I?

0.1: A weapon? I wish I could see a weapon that looks like this.
0.2: A b-bathroom? No! Of course not! Wait, you're not trying to GO here, are you?! I won't allow it!

1.0: Of course it's amazing. A lot of money was spent to bring in a famous scientist.

2.0: Then just go get another copy.
2.2: You want to fight? I won't go easy on you!

yes.0: Still, I can't just let you use it for nothing. Do me a favor first. There are a lot of #o3150002#s around here and I can't stand them. If you eliminate the #r#o3150002#s#k and bring me #b100 #t4000607#s#k, I'll let you use the portal.

no.0: Huh? You're refusing? You really should learn to appreciate the kindness of others. Young people these days...

1.0: You brought all the #t4000607# items. Heheh. Okay, I will let you use the portal.

yes.0: You can use the portal freely with the #t4032766# I just gave you. Say hello to your children for me.

item.0: Have you not obtained the #b100 #t4000607# items#k yet? I really hate those #r#o3150002# enemies#k. They are so ugly...
